image_description: A high-angle landscape photograph featuring a massive, steep cliff face with vertical columnar jointing (likely basalt). The cliff top is covered in green vegetation and grass. In the background, rolling hills and distant mountains are visible under a partly cloudy sky. At the base of the cliff on the right, a sandy beach and ocean waves are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly depicts a sheer vertical drop exceeding 90 degrees in perspective, dominating the composition.
